ownership.evidence: Aura3D registers scene nodes marked with .runtime(game.runtimeNode(id)); app code mutates the returned handles.
Aura3D owns app.onFrame(), app.pause(), app.resume(), and app.step(); app code owns per-frame gameplay decisions.
App code declares action maps, axes, buffering, combos, and when input.update(dt) is called.
App code owns gameplay body state and syncs body snapshots to Aura3D runtime node handles.
Aura3D provides game.collisionWorld() queries/events; app code owns game-specific collision responses.
App code owns actors, teams, hitboxes, move timing, damage, guard, meter, and combat event handling.
App code owns genre-specific score/objective/event semantics; Aura3D event-log helpers type them for evidence.
Aura3D provides pooled effect helpers; app code decides when gameplay events spawn or suppress effects.
Aura3D provides camera director math; app code supplies targets and applies camera state to the route.
Aura3D stores animation clips on runtime nodes; app code chooses clips, restart rules, and timing.
Aura3D typed assets prove catalog/manifest provenance; app code imports typed assets instead of string ids.
Aura3D stage helpers can provide safe bounds; app code owns game-specific rules inside those bounds.
App code owns DOM/text rendering; Aura3D source helpers type HUD bindings for evidence and diagnostics.
App code owns labels, focus, contrast, and pause UI; Aura3D helpers expose source evidence and reduced-motion/reduced-flash flags.

qualityProfile.label: Safe Basic
qualityProfile.claimBoundary: Root createAuraApp safe path. Use this for public examples unless a browser test proves a stronger profile.

exposure.evidence: mini-game UI, aim vectors, and course boundaries stay readable

environment.evidence: procedural fallback environment requested only; runtime environment prefilter status is unavailable until render

screenshotQuality.evidence: prioritizes benchmark screenshots with stronger edge quality for labels, axes, and neon rings

features.label: Base color
features.evidence: AuraMaterialSpec.color and imported GLB baseColorFactor are consumed by the root renderer.
features.claimRule: Can be claimed with a route screenshot.

features.label: Base-color texture
features.evidence: Imported GLB baseColorTexture is sampled by the root WebGL path, but the root material contract currently keeps texture support partial until controlled texture on/off pixels are retained.
features.claimRule: Can describe typed texture metadata and rendered textured assets; do not claim full texture-material parity without controlled root pixels.

features.label: Metallic/roughness
features.evidence: Root material specs expose values, but production-style material response needs route-specific pixel proof.
features.claimRule: Do not claim full PBR parity without browser evidence.

features.label: Normal maps
features.evidence: Root specs carry normal/procedural-normal intent; production shader parity is not guaranteed.
features.claimRule: Claim only with material-specific screenshot evidence.

features.label: Emissive
features.evidence: Root specs and effects expose emissive color; pixel-backed bloom is reported separately.
features.claimRule: Distinguish emissive material from postprocess bloom.

features.label: Alpha/opacity
features.evidence: Opacity is accepted by the public spec, but sorting and blending must be visually verified.
features.claimRule: Verify alpha behavior in screenshots before claiming.

features.label: Double-sided materials
features.evidence: Root diagnostics may preserve metadata, but public material specs do not expose a full double-sided render contract.
features.claimRule: Claim only when tested route shows backface behavior.

features.label: Clearcoat
features.evidence: Root specs and inspectors expose clearcoat values; physically accurate layered highlights need pixel proof.
features.claimRule: Do not call clearcoat physically accurate without renderer evidence.

features.label: Sheen
features.evidence: Root specs expose sheen values for inspection and future renderer binding.
features.claimRule: Treat as partial unless screenshot-proven.

features.label: Transmission/glass
features.evidence: Root specs expose glass intent, opacity, IOR, and thickness; real refraction/volume is not proven in the root path.
features.claimRule: Do not claim real transmission/refraction through root createAuraApp without pixels.

features.label: Material variants
features.evidence: Variant metadata and route logic can be inspected; renderer-level variant switching needs route tests.
features.claimRule: Claim selected variant behavior only when tested.

features.label: HDR/IBL
features.evidence: Root environment nodes request lighting intent; environment prefiltering is not proven in the root path.
features.claimRule: Root HDR/IBL claims require diagnostics and browser pixels.

features.label: Shadow maps
features.evidence: Root path reports contact-shadow cues; production shadow-map sampling is not proven by spec alone.
features.claimRule: Production-shadow claims require pixel proof.

materialCapabilities.claimBoundary: Material diagnostics describe public root createAuraApp support. They are not a substitute for browser screenshot evidence.
